reference.pathophysiology: Severe painful osteoporotic and suitable malignant fractures take cement while burst fractures with neurology go to surgery; pancreatic cancer pain failing opioids yields to celiac neurolysis, facet pain is diagnosed then denervated, and red-flag neurology always means urgent surgery.
